items.fact: Kaplan 2020: power laws in N, D, C; scale N faster than D; link
Chinchilla fixed Kaplan's LR-schedule artefact; N and D scale equally; D ~ 20 tokens/param

Post-Chinchilla over-training; Llama 3 8B ~1,875 tokens/param; inference dominates; smaller model cheaper to serve
Allocation rules treat tokens as interchangeable; data 3.24x more compute-efficiency gain than model 2019-2025, largely independent (Dwarkesh, Sept 2026)
